notes:
Conduct your comics.

Nothing can work out who is speaking a balloon just by looking at the artwork — every way of trying was measured and none of them beats about half. You can, and now it costs almost nothing: tap a name and that character speaks this line and every line after it, until you say otherwise. A page where one person does all the talking costs no taps at all.

Tap + WHO? the first time somebody speaks, give them a name and a voice, and they keep it for the whole series. What you conduct is saved, survives a re-read, and now travels in your backup.

Also in this one: a privacy policy you can read from Settings — pages are recognised on your phone and never uploaded — and proper credit for the open-source pieces the app is built from.
